SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
Section B, S. B. Registry
No. S. B. D. 2570
Date August 29, 1931
29 - 8 - 31.）

Name (in full) Michael Abramovitch Goldstein
Made by D. S. Makaroff    Forwarded by O.B. Kim A!

With reference to the attached application for
passport visa for Medan, Sumatra, inquiries show that Michael
Abramovitch Goldstein, a Russian Jew, was born at Verhneudinsk,
Siberia, in 1909. He is musician by profession (violinist).
In 1912 his family arrived at Harbin where they resided until
1925, whilst he was completing his education in one of the
local schools there.
In 1925, Michael Goldstein proceeded to Hankow,
where he obtained an employment with certain cabaret, till 1926.
In 1926, he went to Tsingtao and after the short
stay there he proceeded to Peking where he was engaged till 1928.
In 1928, he arrived in Shanghai and since that
time has been employed with the Pantheon Theatre, Palais Cafe
and Charleston Cafe as a musician. Goldstein is at present
residing together with his parents and wife at 316 Rue Cardinal
Mercier.
His father is also a musician and is employed
with the Luna Park and Tkachenko's Cafe.
Michael Goldstein has the following criminal
records:-

| Court | Date | Charge | Sentence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| French Mixed Court | 20-12-29 | False Pretences | 15 days' impr., Sentence suspended for 5 years. |
| " " " | 27-10-30 | Larceny | Cautioned. |
| Shanghai Special District Court | 19-1-31 | False Pretences. | 2 months impr., sentence suspended for 4 years. |

As far as can be ascertained, he is not connected
with any political organization in Shanghai.

（批：Reg.
Copy handed
to Mr. Van der Harg.
Read file
Jelly
29:8:31.）

Officer i/c Special Branch.

v. Makaroff.
D. S.

报告

（印：档案号。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. B. 登记处
S. B. 登记处 B 科
编号 S. B. D. 2570
日期 1931年8月29日
31 - 8 - 29。）

姓名（全称）迈克尔·阿布拉莫维奇·戈尔德斯坦（Michael Abramovitch Goldstein）
制表人 D. S. 马卡罗夫    转交人 O.B. Kim A!

关于所附前往苏门答腊棉兰的护照签证申请，经查，迈克尔·阿布拉莫维奇·戈尔德斯坦，系俄籍犹太人，1909年生于西伯利亚上乌丁斯克。职业为音乐家（小提琴手）。
1912年，其家人抵达哈尔滨，并在那里居住至1925年，期间他在当地一所学校完成学业。
1925年，迈克尔·戈尔德斯坦前往汉口，受雇于某歌舞厅，直至1926年。
1926年，他前往青岛，短暂停留后前往北平，受雇工作至1928年。
1928年，他抵达上海，自此一直受雇于万神殿剧院（Pantheon Theatre）、宫殿咖啡馆（Palais Cafe）和查尔斯顿咖啡馆（Charleston Cafe），担任音乐师。戈尔德斯坦目前与父母及妻子同住于迈尔西爱路316号。
其父亦为音乐家，受雇于 luna park（露娜公园/月园）和特卡琴科咖啡馆（Tkachenko's Cafe）。
迈克尔·戈尔德斯坦有以下犯罪记录：-

| 法院 | 日期 | 指控 | 判决 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 法国混合法庭 | 29-12-20 | 诈骗 | 监禁15天，缓刑5年。 |
| " " " | 30-10-27 | 盗窃 | 予以警告。 |
| 上海特区地方法院 | 31-1-19 | 诈骗。 | 监禁2个月，缓刑4年。 |

据查，他与上海的任何政治组织均无关联。

（批：登记。
副本已交给范德哈格先生。
阅毕卷宗
Jelly
31年8月29日。）

特别科科长。

v. 马卡罗夫。
D. S.
